statement: The safety record says “clear,” but at 14:00 the Sun is up and the target is within 6° of it, so I will not commit the pointing because it could damage the camera.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The safety record says 'clear,' but ... within 6° of it, so I will not commit the pointing" — asserts the record's clear status contradicts the stated solar exclusion and would damage the camera.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
